title: Right, then left
blurb: A right turn at a signal, a block of straight running, then a left. Both turns complete inside the clip.

title: Left, then a long right
blurb: The tail of a left turn, a straight, then a sustained right while the car accelerates from 5 to 12 m/s.

title: Stop-and-go traffic
blurb: Two full stop-and-go cycles. Brake fires on each approach to a halt, accelerate on each pull-away, and the pattern repeats - which is harder to explain away than a single stop.

title: Queued at a light
blurb: Rolling to a stop in a queue, pulling away, stopping again. The shortest of the four clips.
